setup.effects: Collect selected migrations and prepare local D1/private owner bootstrap configuration. --remote provisions real D1/R2/Queues and applies remote migrations; no code publication.

deploy.effects: Build, apply local migrations and run Wrangler packaging dry run. --remote publishes the selected prepared Worker/assets and checks native D1/R2 health.

verify.effects: Execute the declared native build/typecheck/runtime verification. Module/browser/provider coverage is recorded separately.

authentication: Remote commands require authenticated Wrangler, CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID, H2H_RESOURCE_PREFIX and H2H_PUBLIC_ORIGIN. Bootstrap/provider secrets remain private. Local checks do not validate credentials.

health.meaning: Native Worker with reachable D1 and R2; does not prove queues, sockets, providers or product acceptance.

acceptance.meaning: Full native HappyToHelp contract; final exact-source acceptance remains evidence-owned.

configuration.description: Native DB/FILES/JOBS/CONVERSATIONS bindings and scheduled recovery; generated migrations are collected before setup.
Selected optional runtime variable and private-secret allowlists; values never appear in describe/plan.
Clean install, target setup/publication, provider configuration and resumable local legacy import.

notes: Requires Node >=26.8.1 and locked pnpm installation. Use pnpm run setup, not pnpm setup.
PHP/Laravel/MySQL/Redis/Lambda are not delivered runtime dependencies.
No hosted, paid-provider or production-data migration claim follows from describe/check or a local packaging dry run.
